summary.text: William D. "Bill" Pluecker, an Independent, represents House District 44 (Hope, Union and Warren, Knox County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Warren. The House profile lists service as chair of the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives farmer as the occupation and a B.A. (1999) as the degree.
It lists Chloe Maxmin as spouse and two children.
